Current evidence is more consistent with advancing continuation and a possible pre-rotation transition than with confirmed broad altseason or distribution. The most material changes are stronger proxy breadth, positive BTC and ETH performance across the available 4-hour to 24-hour windows, and persistent ETH/BTC trading above 0.03. Countervailing evidence includes negative ETH short-term microstructure, elevated sentiment and funding, mixed longer-horizon rotation data, negative settled ETF totals, and incomplete 1-hour coverage. This remains shadow calibration only; the forecast candidates are unratified research objects.
